mapper.select: select cm.id, cm.session_id, cm.sender_id, cm.receiver_id, cm.type, cm.content, cm.read_status, cm.read_time, cm.create_time, case when cm.sender_id = #{currentUserId} then true else false end as mine from chatmessage cm where cm.session_id = #{sessionId} order by cm.create_time desc, cm.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}
